post_topic: Unowned cloud spend and ungoverned infrastructure as a carrying cost CTOs normalize instead of fix
scene_description: A split visual shows an ungoverned cloud environment on one side — a tangled web of untagged AWS or cloud resources, IAM policy documents, muted alert dashboards, and failing CI/CD pipelines accumulating at 2am — contrasted on the other side with the Cloud Decoded agentic infrastructure management interface showing clean governance controls and human-in-the-loop approval steps. In the foreground, Kelvin Davis — a Black/African American man in his late 30s to 40s, short hair with some grey at the temples and a short neatly trimmed beard/goatee — reviews a widening gap diagram between 'deployed' and 'documented' states on a monitor. The tension is between the rational individual decisions that collectively produce infrastructure nobody owns and the governed, auditable alternative Cloud Decoded is built to deliver.
